doctrine: StatsPlus enhances. It does not replace.

signals.allowed_use: Describe modeled race pressure and probability.
signals.disallowed_use: Do not replace standings or present probability as destiny.
signals.caution_language: StatsPlus model output; raw OOTP governs records and standings.

signals.allowed_use: Compare modeled strength and recent movement.
signals.disallowed_use: Do not call ELO an official record or guaranteed future result.
Do not label residuals luck or promise regression.
signals.caution_language: Expected-performance model; game results remain raw proof.

signals.allowed_use: Add team-value composition and strength context.
signals.disallowed_use: Do not equate WAR rank with standings or postseason outcome.
signals.caution_language: StatsPlus WAR definition must remain labeled.

signals.disallowed_use: Do not attribute a result to injury without player/game linkage.
signals.caution_language: Aggregate context only; avoid unsupported causation.

signals.allowed_use: Add measured fan-interest, attendance scale, and historical trend.
signals.disallowed_use: Do not infer emotion, motives, or clubhouse effects.
signals.caution_language: Measured context is not sentiment testimony.

signals.disallowed_use: Do not infer blame, intent, or future transactions.
signals.caution_language: Financial context creates questions, not conclusions.

signals.allowed_use: Add named personnel and structured current traits.
signals.disallowed_use: Do not infer motives/tendencies; owner mood/objectives/goals and staff IDs are unavailable.
signals.caution_language: Manual reference only until identity/tendency rules expand.

signals.key_fields: Team|ML Age|ML P Age|ML B Age|minor-level ages
signals.disallowed_use: Do not infer development success or decline from age alone.

signals.allowed_use: Discover ranked standout batting games for investigation.
signals.disallowed_use: Do not use as official game proof without raw verification.
signals.caution_language: StatsPlus ranking; crosscheck raw game data before publication.

signals.disallowed_use: Do not use as official game proof without raw verification.
